panels.desc: A party on the far bank of the Word Pond under strings of paper lanterns, with the finished bridge of stepping stones behind. A long low table on the grass holds brown mugs, blue star cups, sesame buns, purple figs and a steaming red pot. Guests sit around it: the pink pig, the brown puppy, the fox (now friendly), the ox, the white pup and the ten hens. Bun points at the table; Hedgie carries a tray; Pip sings on a lantern string; Beads hangs a garland of beads. Hidden in the picture: a mug, a bun, a fig, the pot, a cup. Grumble does NOT appear — only his lantern light far off in the reeds across the water.

lines.text: A mug, a bun, a fig!

panels.desc: Party games on the bank: the pig stands on a stone holding a golden trophy after winning a race, and the white pup digs a hole with dirt flying. Everyone turns to look: Grumble is walking across the stepping-stone bridge toward the party, lantern held in front of him, nightcap pinned, with a shy hopeful face; Bun and Hedgie wave him over with both arms; Pip flies out to meet him; Beads clicks its beads. Hidden in the picture: the pig, the pup, the trophy, the digging hole.

Grumble sits in the middle of the party beating the upturned red pot like a drum with two wooden spoons, grinning wide with his nightcap bouncing; everyone hops around him — Bun, Hedgie, the pig, the fox, the pup. Pip stands on a log reading out the words painted on the party stones; Beads conducts with a string of beads. Hidden in the picture: the pot drum, the log, an open box of party hats, the green bug on a cup, a jacket with a zipper hanging on a branch.

Night. The party has gone quiet: everyone stands at the edge of the far bank looking into the dark pine forest, where two small identical wisps of pale light hover side by side between the trees, like two little puffs of breath. Grumble holds his lantern up on a stick; Hedgie points at Grumble with a questioning face; Grumble shrugs with both paws up; Beads's antennae stand straight up; Pip tilts its head listening; Bun hugs the striped rug around her. Hidden in the picture: the rug, the first-aid kit on the table, the spinning top on a stone, the fox peeking from behind a tree.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the raccoon beats the upturned pot with two spoons and his nightcap bounces, the friends and animals hop in a circle, paper lanterns sway, the baby bird on the log sings little golden notes. Camera still. Festive, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: at night two small identical wisps of pale light drift side by side between the dark pine trees and pulse twice, the friends' ears and antennae perk up, the raccoon holds his lantern higher and shrugs. Camera still. Mysterious but friendly, child-friendly. No text.
